title: Transferring funds to external banks: Bronze Saver
summary: This document explains transferring funds to external banks from the Bronze Saver account via ACH and domestic wire. Standard ACH takes 3 business days (no same-day ACH) with a $5,000/day outgoing limit; domestic outgoing wires cost $25 and can deliver faster than ACH.
faqs: How long do standard ACH transfers take to an external bank from Bronze Saver?
Is same-day ACH available for outgoing transfers?
What is the maximum amount I can transfer out per day via ACH?
If my ACH transfer exceeds $5,000, what should I do?
